title: 第15章 四族密谋第16章 先天圆满
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界
content_zh:
“周老祖，落阴山天阴宗，天阴老人的威名，我等岂会不知？”莫家老祖满脸狐疑地看向周家老祖，似乎对他突然提起天阴老人感到十分不解。
莫家老祖心中暗自思忖：这周家老祖怎么会无缘无故地说起天阴老人呢？难道天阴老人和李家之间有什么关联不成？
不光是莫家老祖心生疑惑，袁家老祖和黄家老祖也不约而同地将目光投向了周家老祖，脸上同样露出疑惑的神情。
落阴山的天阴宗，虽然只是一个散修宗门，但其实力却不容小觑。
尤其是天阴老人，他在落阴山地界可是声名远扬，无人不知无人不晓。
而且，天阴老人还是一位先天圆满强者。
其实力之强，绝非普通先天圆满强者所能匹敌的存在。
但由于天阴老人手段狠辣，杀伐果断，因此他们也都只是听过其威名，却没有接触过对方。
周家老祖轻抚着自己的胡须，面带微笑地看着对面三人。
当他注意到三人脸上露出的疑惑神情时，他轻笑一声，开口解释道：
“呵呵，据我所知，李老鬼早年和天阴老人之间存在一些过节。
如果我们能让天阴老人得知李老鬼突破失败，实力大减，你们猜猜看，他会有怎样的反应呢？”
周家老祖的话音刚落，莫家老祖的眼睛突然一亮，瞬间便明白了周家老祖的意图。
他若有所思地说道：“你是说天阴老人和李老鬼之间有过节……”
一旁的黄家老祖和袁家老祖对视一眼，他们的眼中也闪过一丝惊讶之色。
显然，对于这个消息，他们之前并不知晓。
然而，莫家老祖并没有被这个消息所迷惑，他冷静下来看向周家老祖，说道：“你的方法虽然听起来可行，但要是天阴老人发现是我们在背后利用他，这岂不是会与他结下仇怨？”
“此举不是在自找麻烦？”他看向周家老祖问道！
莫家老祖的担忧不无道理，毕竟天阴老人是个心狠手辣的人物。
如果让他知道是他们在背后利用他去对付李家，恐怕过后会给他们几家带来不少麻烦。

听到莫家老祖所言，黄家老祖以及袁家老祖也都反应了过来。
“是啊，天阴宗虽然是一个散修宗门，但其实力也不容小觑，与他们交恶实非明智之举啊！”黄家老祖面色凝重地说道。
面对其他三位老祖的质疑，周家老祖却显得异常镇定，他面不改色地看着众人，缓声道：“诸位，若是我等与他合作呢？”
他心里也很清楚，若只是暗中利用天阴老人，那势必会与天阴宗结下仇怨，但若是能够与天阴老人达成合作，情况或许就会有所不同。
“周老祖，你就如此笃定天阴老人会愿意与我等合作？”袁家老祖眉头微皱，凝视着周老祖，追问道。
袁家老祖的顾虑不无道理，毕竟天阴老人若真有能力独自抗衡李家老祖，又何必与他们四大家族联手呢？
content_en:
"Old Ancestor Zhou, from the Luoyin Mountain Tianyin Sect, how could I not know the reputation of Old Man Tianyin?" The Mo Family Ancestor looked at the Zhou Family Ancestor with a suspicious face, as if he was very puzzled by his sudden mention of Old Man Tianyin.
The ancestor of the Mo family secretly thought: How could the ancestor of the Zhou family talk about old man Tianyin for no reason this time? Is there some connection between old man Tianyin and the Li family?
Not only the ancestors of the Mo family were confused, but the ancestors of the Yuan family and the Huang family also turned their attention to the ancestors of the Zhou family, with the same puzzled expressions on their faces.
Although the Tianyin Sect in Luoyin Mountain is only a casual cultivating sect, its strength cannot be underestimated.
Especially Old Man Tianyin, he has a far-reaching reputation in the Luoyin Mountain area, and everyone knows about him.
Moreover, Old Man Tianyin is also an innately perfect and powerful person.
Its strength is beyond the reach of ordinary innate and perfect beings.
However, due to Old Man Tianyin's ruthless tactics and decisive killing, they had only heard of his reputation but had never come into contact with him.
The ancestor of the Zhou family gently stroked his beard and looked at the three people opposite him with a smile.
When he noticed the doubtful expressions on the faces of the three people, he chuckled and explained:
"Haha, as far as I know, there were some disputes between Old Ghost Li and Old Man Tianyin in his early years.
If we can let Old Man Tianyin know that Old Ghost Li failed to break through and his strength has been greatly reduced, guess what kind of reaction he will have? "
As soon as the ancestor of the Zhou family finished speaking, the ancestor of the Mo family suddenly lit up, and he instantly understood the intention of the ancestor of the Zhou family.
He said thoughtfully: "You mean there is a feud between old man Tianyin and old ghost Li..."
The ancestors of the Huang family and the ancestors of the Yuan family looked at each other, and a trace of surprise flashed in their eyes.
Obviously, they didn't know this news before.
However, the ancestor of the Mo family was not confused by the news. He calmed down and looked at the ancestor of the Zhou family and said, "Although your method sounds feasible, if Old Man Tianyin finds out that we are using him behind his back, won't we create a grudge against him?"
"Aren't you asking for trouble with this move?" He looked at the ancestor of the Zhou family and asked!
The concerns of the ancestor of the Mo family are not unreasonable. After all, old man Tianyin is a ruthless person.
If he knew that they were using him behind the scenes to deal with the Li family, I'm afraid it would cause them a lot of trouble in the future.
After hearing what the ancestor of the Mo family said, the ancestors of the Huang family and the ancestors of the Yuan family also reacted.
"Yes, although Tianyin Sect is a casual cultivating sect, its strength cannot be underestimated. It is not wise to make enemies with them!" The ancestor of the Huang family said with a solemn expression.
Facing the doubts of the other three ancestors, the ancestor of the Zhou family seemed unusually calm. He looked at everyone without changing his expression and said slowly: "Everyone, what if we cooperate with him?"
He also knew very well that if he only used Old Man Tianyin secretly, he would inevitably become enmity with Tianyin Sect, but if he could cooperate with Old Man Tianyin, the situation might be different.
"Ancestor Zhou, are you so sure that Old Man Tianyin will be willing to cooperate with us?" Ancestor of the Yuan family frowned slightly, stared at Ancestor Zhou, and asked.
The concerns of the ancestor of the Yuan family are not unreasonable. After all, if old man Tianyin is really capable of confronting the ancestor of the Li family on his own, why would he join forces with the four major families?
